notes.title: Polter Pals is in the PAX x EGX Indie Showcase!
notes.content:
Polter Pals was one of 20 games selected to be in the PAX x EGX Indie Showcase! There's an updated demo live on the store page for you to enjoy, and I'll be taking part in the digital convention fun all week. Throughout the week, I'll be streaming here and on Twitch, so stop by and say hello or ask some questions!

Events for Steam streams will be posted here in advance, and my Twitch streaming schedule will be available on my Twitch page!

Don't forget to check out the demo and give Polter Pals a wishlist if you enjoy it! If you'd like to keep up to date with the game, follow me at the links below.
